messages:
alex: Heads-up — small change window tonight 23:30 UTC. We need to roll a runtime kernel tweak (qkv patch) and a header change in API that requires a router header split and a console schema toggle. Will coordinate cutover across services. Can anyone confirm safe gaps/rollback criteria?

jess: runtime team — can do a canary at 23:30, full roll at 23:40. Will publish a pinned variant (runtime-v2.3.1) and keep v2.3.0 as fallback. Need a 5m stabilize window after canary.

maria: router — header-split needs to be staged. We prefer a 10m gap between router change and runtime cutover to let route caches expire. Also, watch backend health; evictions possible during kernel bump.

taylor: console — dashboard schema toggle is backwards-compatible, but we'll need to flip feature flag at cutover time. Putting a post-deploy migration to run at +15m; if rollback happens we need to revert the flag first.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary at 2025-07-02T23:30:00Z -> runtime service runtime-v2.3.1 (5%) ; router header-split at 23:37 (canary) ; console flag flip scheduled at 23:45. I will post status updates in-thread. Use `/deploy abort <id>` for rollback.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/cutovers/kernel-qkv

alex: Proposed sequence: 1) runtime canary 23:30 2) wait 5m stabilize 3) router canary 23:37 4) router full 23:47 5) runtime full 23:50 6) console flag +15m. Agree?

jess: OK but swap steps 4/5: do router full before runtime full, otherwise router will route to new header but old runtime may not accept. So router full at 23:47, runtime full 23:50 works.

maria: Confirmed, router team will watch 429/502 spikes. If we see >1% error-rate or latency p50 doubles, we rollback router to header-old.

taylor: Console will hold off flag flip until runtime is full and router is stable for 10m. If rollback, we'll flip the flag back and trigger the migration revert.

alex: Rollback criteria agreed: any service >1% errors for 5m, or latency spike p95 x2 for 3m. If triggered, we do staged rollback: console flag -> runtime -> router. Jess please paste rollback commands.

jess: Rollback snippet:
```
# rollback runtime
/deploy abort runtime-v2.3.1-canary
/deploy promote runtime-v2.3.0

# rollback router
/deploy abort router-header-split
/deploy promote router-header-old
```

alex: Thanks. Also adding release notes line: "Small qkv kernel fix + API header split; fallback to runtime-v2.3.0 and header-old supported." I'll update the release notes pre-cutover. @deploybot post the canary link when it starts :thumbsup:

deploybot: canary started: https://deploys/internal/1788888888/runtime-v2.3.1-canary

maria: seeing slight 429 bump in canary (0.3%) — watching. No action yet.

jess: runtime metrics look fine on canary. Proceed to router canary at 23:37.

deploybot: router canary started: https://deploys/internal/1788888888/router-header-canary

alex: Everyone stay on this thread for status updates. If we hit rollback criteria call it in 0-2-1.

taylor: noted. I'll hold migrations.

ops-runbook-bot: Alert: if rollback executed, notify #incidents and run network quiesce per runbook.

alex: Thanks all. Post-mortem check-in tomorrow at 10:00. :sparkles:
